title: A-142: from scattered brake reports to a governed decision
question: When a reported brake fault repeats and becomes safety-critical, what evidence supports holding the asset from service, and who authorizes the decision?
summary: Follow six synthetic reports through an evidence-backed review, a deterministic repeat-event rule and a recorded approval. Inspect the implementation behind each step before considering a workflow pilot.
attribution: Built by Shekib and the Kaamchor team.
disclosures: Synthetic demonstration only: every organisation, person and operational report in this case is fictional.
Deterministic fixture intelligence returns authored, checksum-bound extraction objects. The 70% confidence is authored fixture data, not a measured live-model result.
The recording uses Playwright to exercise the application's authenticated human-governed review and approval controls. No maintenance lead was consulted.
Recorded approval authorizes a proposed decision. It does not establish physical removal, completed repairs, production deployment or measured savings.

sources.label: Earlier completed brake work
sources.context: The maintenance CSV reports brake pad replacement and a responsive pedal after repair. Completion belongs to this earlier work order, not closure of the later case.

sources.label: Grinding and spongy pedal reported
sources.context: The operator describes a recurring symptom and vaguely recalls spring brake work. The previous-repair reference is the field sent to review.

sources.label: Follow-up inspection
sources.context: The report describes uneven pad wear and fluid weeping, recommending a full diagnostic. This PDF fixture is text with page markers, not binary PDF parsing.

sources.label: Brakes fail to hold on the yard ramp
sources.context: The operator reports rollback under load and parking the asset. This is authored source content, separately inspectable from the application's recorded state.

sources.label: Supervisor requests a hold from service
sources.context: The email assembles the dated history and asks for review and sign-off before return to service.

sources.label: Authored repair update: further work remains
sources.context: The source reports tow, lockout and parts awaiting arrival. It is frozen narrative evidence; the capture does not claim to perform those physical actions or to complete this repair.

stages.title: Keep uncertainty inspectable
stages.explanation: The vague spring repair reference carries authored 70% confidence and its original passage. The review queue shows it pending; the scripted visitor accepts it through the real UI, and an observation-accepted audit records the transition.

stages.title: Evaluate an explicit repeat-event rule
stages.explanation: The predicate requires a safety-critical severity observation AND at least two related events within 1,440 hours (60 days). The related-event aggregate counts related events; it does not require every counted event to be safety-critical. The displayed resolved count is captured from the real rule trace.

stages.title: Propose work without authorizing it
stages.explanation: The matched rule proposes a critical-risk remove-from-service decision under the Asset Removal Approval policy. The pending export establishes its awaiting-approval state before the scripted visitor acts.

stages.title: Record the governed authorization
stages.explanation: The approval dialog disables confirmation until a comment is supplied. The synthetic script supplies an explicit demonstration comment. The Approval, Decision and approval audit must share consistent references, outcome and time.

stages.title: Keep authorization and completion distinct
stages.explanation: The final export supplies the open case and actual action-item states. No action completion, repair outcome or business benefit is inferred from the approved Decision.

capabilities.title: Evidence-backed extraction
capabilities.explanation: Checksum-bound fixtures, validated output and original evidence spans keep every derived observation inspectable.

capabilities.title: Human review at the uncertainty boundary
capabilities.explanation: A pending field is accepted through a session-scoped UI action that preserves review history and appends audit evidence.

capabilities.title: Explainable deterministic policy
capabilities.explanation: A pack-owned predicate evaluates severity and related-event history separately, with the resolved aggregate visible in the rule inspector.

capabilities.title: Approval separated from execution
capabilities.explanation: The application persists a distinct Approval before updating a Decision; capture verifies that linkage and preserves outstanding case work.

capabilities.title: One configurable operational architecture
capabilities.explanation: Scenario Packs supply domain vocabulary, schemas and policy while the shared lifecycle and export services remain neutral.

capture.approvalComment: Synthetic automated approval for demonstration only. Authorize the proposed A-142 hold; no maintenance lead was consulted and no physical work is performed by this script.
